summary.text: Jon Bonck is a Houston-area mortgage sales manager with a background in quality control and marketing in the biochemical and petroleum industries. He won the Republican nomination for the open 38th District in a May 26, 2026 primary runoff. He has not completed Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, so his stated priorities are not documented on that page.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in biochemistry from Louisiana State University.
Worked in quality control in the biochemical and petroleum industries.
Moved into a marketing role with Nalco Champion in 2015.
Became a sales manager at Bonck & Baker Mortgage Group in 2019, where he worked as of the 2026 primary.
Finished first in the 10-candidate March 3, 2026 Republican primary with 46.8% and won the May 26 runoff against Shelly deZevallos with 64.8%.
